comments: You can use the File option and add a name with the .txt or other extention you would like to use.

I know that why i have left the request open. Just telling you how to make one in the current state.

I've restarted my PC and "New Text document" option has appeared in the Explorer... But not in the Files.

review_comments:
@gave92 removing the `async` results in unwrapped returns, it propagates `NullReferenceException` to the caller

we should either restore the async, or manually wrap the non-Task return values in `Task.FromResult<ShellNewEntry?>(null)`
